extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.33[CR]- Give In Progress, Purchases and Search immediate, independent headings and multi-line guidance.[CR]- Remove the heading-reset bug and previous-section card/frozen-art leakage during personal-tab transitions.[CR]- Dispatch fresh In Progress and Purchases requests directly on reserved workers, bypassing catalog wait queues.[CR]- Extract personal-page JSON without parsing unrelated storefront movie cards; record extraction and request timings.[CR]- Recognize explicit native purchase-library payloads, nested navigation links and empty-library states.[CR]- Display the requested no-purchased-media message only for a confirmed empty library, with separate retrieval-failure wording.[CR]- Show Search instructions and explain the full Prime Video catalog scope before opening the search keyboard.[CR]- Preserve fresh uncached In Progress, single-row browsing, genre artwork, early paging and playback return.

extension.description: Delivers updates for the standalone Prime Scene add-on. The index is now hosted by ScottyWins.
